main.method: stationary bootstrap of the target returns (Politis-Romano), resampled within the training and test blocks separately, shared by all draws of a path; null v4 calendar window
main.block_rule: Politis-White stationary block length of squared target returns, floor 3, cap OOS/4

sensitivity.method: circular moving-block bootstrap, fixed blocks of 2L (sensitivity)

main.escalation_rule: sensitivity B=99 by default, extended to 199 (the next 100 paths of the same seeded stream) when the primary and the sensitivity disagree or when ||T - c| - q| / q < 0.2 on either; fixed before the fleet run (Lead 2026-10-20, Codex option-C review)
main.screening_note: diagnostic only, never part of the pass / fail; raised -> construction review

construction_review.ref: the construction-review note in this section
